description: This file defines a data model class 'Note' used in a note-taking app, including properties, constructors, copy, serialization, and deserialization methods.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: A data class representing a note with fields for id, title, content, createdAt, and updatedAt, along with methods for copying, mapping, and creating from a map.

methods.name: copyWith
methods.description: Creates a copy of the Note with optional new values for its properties.

methods.name: fromMap
methods.description: Factory constructor that creates an instance of Note from a Map<String, dynamic>.

methods.name: toMap
methods.description: Converts the Note instance into a Map<String, dynamic> for serialization.
